resources.string: Use 2–3 common English words. "Hey Google" and "Hey Siri" are reserved by Google Assistant and Siri, so pick your own phrase, like "hey music" or "okay jukebox".
After the beep, just say the song

Say the wake phrase, wait for the beep, then say the song, artist, album or playlist name, e.g. "Bohemian Rhapsody" or "Tarkan Kuzu Kuzu". The app repeats what it heard ("Playing …") and starts it in YouTube Music. If it didn't hear you, it asks once more.

Other commands: "open YouTube Music", "next", "previous", "pause", "resume", "volume up", "volume down" (Turkish: "sonraki", "önceki", "durdur", "devam", "sesi aç", "sesi kıs").

If a song title is also a command (like "Stop"), say "play" first: "play Stop".
